newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian firm in plane deal with McDonnell Douglas.
newsitem.headline: Italian firm in plane deal with McDonnell Douglas.

text.p: Alenia, a unit of Italian state-controlled engineering group Finmeccanica, said Thursday it signed a $410 million deal with McDonnell Douglas Corp. to modify a fleet of DC10 aircraft.
Alenia said the agreement involved converting 13 DC10-10s into cargo aircraft from passenger planes. The contract included an option for the modification of another 30 DC10s.
The cargo planes were destined for Federal Express, based in Memphis, which is expanding its operations.
It did not say when the aircraft would be delivered.
The modifications will be carried out by an Alenia division, Aeronavali, which specialises in transforming McDonnell Douglas DC8s and DC10s.
"The modifications will require major work to the structure and the systems of the aircraft," Alenia said.
